svg.title: Ketover doubled planes: two sheets joined by six necks
svg.desc: Original genus-five topology schematic. Six smooth necks arranged around a circle join upper and lower sheets, each continuing to a conical end. A vertical cutaway reveals the gap and neck walls. No shrinker equation has been solved; two ends are proved only for sufficiently large genus.

g.text: Two sheets, joined through a ring of necks
Ketover doubled planes · genus 5 illustration · 6 necks
One connected surface; both sheets continue outward
Cutaway: the sheets meet along the neck walls
g + 1 bridges between two punctured planes give genus g and two ends.
Blue and gold distinguish the two sides of the surface. Outer rims and cut edges are display boundaries.
SCHEMATIC · no exact formula or numerical solution of the shrinker equation
Two ends are proved only for sufficiently large genus; this drawing does not specify a threshold.
